ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.
ui_help23.wording:
Atyik un tab para u fanmamostra i ramienta-ña. «Atan» tutuhun gi «Muebi i mostra»; gi «Dibuhu» guaha «Dibuhu», «Sileksión» yan «Na'hålum». «Muebi i mostra» ha muebi i mostra sin dibuhu. Na'hihot pat na'chågu' i dos na kålulot para un tulaika i zoom. I flecha gi fi'on i tab siha ha na'attuk i panel. Guaha na'an kada ramienta. Usa «Tulaika» para un tulaika i påtti ni ma'atyik, i kåntun brin, i mineddung, pat i pinenta.

Gi «Kulot» siña un atyik i kulot para un fa'tinas pinenta (FG) yan i kulot para i brin (BG). «Tulaika i lugåt i kulot siha» ha tulaika i lugåt i dos; «Na'åttilong yan na'å'paka' ta'lu» ha na'ta'lu i dos na kulot. I ramienta para un atyik kulot ha na'annuk ensegidas i kulot ni un atyik. «Usa kulot» ha aksepta i inatyik; «Kansela» ha na'ta'lu i primet na kulot. Usa «Na'halom kulot» pat patcha un lugåt ni tåya' kulot para un atyik yan po'lu un kulot. Patcha ya go'ti un kulot ni mapo'lu para un tulaika pat na'suha. «Mås inatyik siha» gaigi gi fi'on «Na'åttilong yan na'å'paka' ta'lu». Ha baba i editor ni guaha mås inatyik para i kulot.

«Råya siha gi kantun kada pixel» ha na'annuk lokkui' i regla para i pixels gi pinenta. Yanggin un usa i cursor para un fa'tinas pinenta, mamostra i lugåt-ña (X/Y) gi fi'on i zoom ya matulaika an mamuyi i cursor.

«Po'lu kumu…» para un atyik i klåsin dokumentu, i inatyik para u mafa'dikiki' i dokumentu, yan i lugåt para u mapo'lu. «Po'lu» ha po'lu ta'lu gi mesmu na lugåt yan i mesmu na inatyik siha. «Po'lu un sahngi na kopia…» ha fa'tinas un dokumentu ICO, un pinenta gi tinige' ASCII, pat un tinige' Base64; ti ha marka i dibuhu kumu mapo'lu. «Po'lu yan kumpåtti» ha po'lu un kopia, pues baba i inatyik Android para un kumpåtti. Ti matulaika i lugåt ni ma'usa på'gu para «Po'lu».

Gi «Dibuhu > Na'hålum > Otro siha na imåhen» guaha dokumentu ginin i tråstis, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart yan «Wikimedia Commons · Mapa siha ni tåya' tinige'…». I pinenta ni mana'hålum ma'atyik trabiha. Mamostra i go'tihan-ña maskeseha gaigi gi huyong i brin. «Tulaika i mineddung i pinenta para u hålum gi brin» ha tulaika i lugåt-ña gi brin; «Urihinåt na mineddong» ha na'ta'lu i mineddung i urihinåt na pinenta.

An un baba ta'lu i app, i autosave ha na'ta'lu i kopia para cho'chu' yan i rekot para un na'lo gi estådo åntis pat un rinueba i tinilaika. Gi «Dokumentu» guaha lokkui' «Dinanña' i pinenta siha», «Taimanu para un usa AN Paint» yan «Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas». Siña un na'hålum tinige' gi banda pat disdi sanhilu' asta sanpapa'.

ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.
ui_help23.wording: Xictlapehpeni ce pestana para tiquittaz tlen hueli ticchihuaz. «Xiquitta» pehua ica «Xictotoxo ixcopincayotl para tiquittaz»; pan «Xicpa» oncah tlen hueli ica titlapa, «Xictlapehpeni» huan «Xictlali». Tlan zan tictotoxoa para tiquittaz, ax titlapa. Ica ome momahpil xicnechco zo xiciyocatlali para ma neci maz huei zo maz cuecuetztzin. Mitl tlen eltoc ininacas pestanas quitzacua campa neci tlen hueli ticchihuaz. Nochi tlen ica titequiti quipiya itoca. «Xicpatla» quipatla tlen tictlapehpenqui, inepamitl campa titlapa, ihuexca zo ixcopincayotl. «Ixnezcayotl» quipiya ixnezcayotl tlen mocahua iixpan huan iica; «Xicpatla iixpan huan iica» quincuepa, huan «Zampa xictequihui yayahuic / chipahuac» zampa quintlalia. Nimantzin neci ixnezcayotl tlen tictlapehpenia. «Xictequihui ni ixnezcayotl» quicahua nopa ixnezcayotl; tlan ticcahua ni tequitl, zampa mocahua ixnezcayotl tlen achtohui. «Xicahcocui ixnezcayotl» zo xictlali huan nimantzin xicquixti momahpil pan ce lugar tlen axquipiya ixnezcayotl para tictlapehpeniz huan ticahcocuiz ce ixnezcayotl. Xiccahua momahpil pan ce ixnezcayotl tlen quiahcoucqui AN Paint para ticpatlaz zo ticquixtiz. «Achi miac tlen hueli ticpatlaz», inacas yayahuic / chipahuac, quitlapoa campa hueli ticpatlaz ocsequi tlen quipiya ixnezcayotl. «Inepamitl cehce pixel» noihqui quimanextia reglas ica pixels; quemman titlapa ica cursor, neci x/y campa eltoc namantzin inacas tlen quipatla quen huei neci ixcopincayotl. «Xicahcocui» hueli quicahua tictlapehpeniz tlamantli amatl, quen ticpitzahuaz huan campa ticahcocuiz; tlan zan ticahcocui zampa, quintequihuia nopa tlen tictlapehpenqui. Tlan ticquixtia ce copia, AN Paint quichihua ICO, ixcopincayotl ica ASCII zo tlahcuilolli Base64, zan axquimanextia quen ixcopincayotl tlen ya quiahcoucqui. «Xicahcocui huan xictitlani» quiahcocui ce copia, teipan quitlapoa campa Android quititlani; axquipatla campa ticahcocui namantzin. Pan «Xicpa → Xictlali → Cequinoc ixcopincayotl» oncah amatl tlen dispositivo, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart huan «Wikimedia Commons · Tlaltlachiyaliztli tlen axquipiya tlahcuilolli…». Ixcopincayotl tlen ticcalactia mocahua tlapehpentoc; neci campa hueli tiquihcuenia, noihqui tlan eltoc quiyahuac campa titlapa. Tlan tictlalia ixcopincayotl ma eli iihtic campa titlapa, mopatla campa eltoc; «Ihuexca tlen achtohui» zampa quicahua quen eltoya ihuexca. Tlen AN Paint quiahcocui icelti zampa mocahua quemman zampa tictlapoa, huan hueli tictequihuia «Zampa xiccahua quen eltoya» huan «Zampa xicchihua» ica tlen eltoya achtohui. «Amatl» noihqui quipiya tlatecpanilli tlen ixcopincayotl, quen tictequihuiz AN Paint huan «Tlahcuiloliztli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan acquiya quichiuhqui ni tequitl». Tlan tictlalia tlahcuilolli, hueli tictlalia tlen iarrabez hasta inemah zo tlen itzonco hasta itzintlan.

ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.wording:
Xictlali hasta 20 ixcopincayotl ica campa Android mitzchihualtia xictlapehpeni amatl. Itzintlan neci ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzitzi, inintoca amatl, ihuexca ixcopincayotl satepan tlen tictequi huan tlen ticpatla ica «San ce ipatlauhca» zo «San ce ihuahcapanyo», huan quemman quipatlaque amatl tlan quitemaca nopa tlahcuiloliztli campa ticcui amatl. Xiquintecpana ica inintoca amatl zo quemman quipatlaque. Ixcopincayotl tlen ya tictlalih axmoolinia.

Xictlali huan nimantzin xicquixti momahpil pan ce ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzin para tictlapehpeniz. «Xictequi ixcopincayotl» quitequi san nopa ixcopincayotl; tlan tiquintequi miac san ce huelta, hueli tictlalia quezqui pixels zo por ciento ticquixtiz pan itenno cehce ixcopincayotl tlen tictlapehpenqui. Xictotoxo campa hueli tiquihcuenia itenno zo xiquihcuilo quezqui ticquixtiz. «Zampa xiccahua quen eltoya itenno» zampa quicahua itenno quen eltoya. Tlan tictequi, axquipatla amatl tlen achtohui, huan hueli zampa ticcahua quen eltoya.

Xiccahua momahpil ce tlatoctzin pan ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzin, zo xictotoxo ce ixcopincayotl tlen ya tictlalih; xiccahua pan itenno tlen neci ocachi. Campa neci ixcopincayotl quen hueli titlachia iica, tiquitta canin mochijtoc tlan mopepechoa. Tlan mopepechoa pan inemah, motlalia san ce campa itzonco; tlan mopepechoa itzintlan, motlalia san ce campa iarrabez. Noihqui hueli xictlapehpeni ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzin huan teipa +. Tlan mopepechoa ixcopincayotl, tlen achtohui pehua pan (0, 0). Tlan tictequi ixcopincayotl campa mopepechojtoque ocsequi, nopa ocsequi hueli moolinia. Tlan mopepechoa ixcopincayotl, axhueli mocahua ce ixcopincayotl ipan ceyoc.

Xictlapehpeni ce ixcopincayotl huan xictequihui campa hueli tictlalia melahuac para tictlaliz X/Y tlen itzonco iarrabez, ica pixels enteros tlen pehua pan 0. Ocsequi ixcopincayotl mocahua campa eltoya, huan hueli mocahua ce ipan ceyoc.

«San ce ipatlauhca» huan «San ce ihuahcapanyo» quintlalia nochi ixcopincayotl san ce ipatlauhca zo ihuahcapanyo, zan cehce quicahua quen eltoya ipatlauhca ica ihuahcapanyo. Xictlapehpeni pixels, por ciento, tlen ocachi cuecuetztzin zo tlen ocachi huei. Xiccuepa ihuexca tlen achtohui para nochi occepa quipiya ihuexca tlen eltoya, zan mocahua tlen tictequi.

Tlan tiquihcuenia, san ixcopincayotl tlen tictlapehpenqui mocuepa itzintlan. Ocsequi mocahua campa eltoya; tlen mopepechtoque hueli moolinia para quitemitiz campa polihui. Tlan ticquixtia, san nopa ixcopincayotl mopohpohua. «Zampa xiccahua quen eltoya» huan «Zampa xicchihua» quicuepa tlen mopatlac. Xictotoxo ce ixcopincayotl tlen ya tictlalih para tiquihcueniz; xictotoxo campa axoncah ixcopincayotl para tihcueniz tlen tiquitta. Ica ome momahpil xicnechco zo xiciyocatlali para ma neci maz huei zo maz cuecuetztzin. «Xiquitta nochi» quipatla quen huei neci para ma tiquitta nochi nopa tlatecpanilli; axquipatla ihuexca ixcopincayotl tlen AN Paint quichihuaz.

«Xicahcocui (PNG)» quiahcocui nopa ixcopincayotl tlatecpanilli. «Xicpatla pan Paint» quihuica campa titequiti para quipatla ixcopincayotl tlen eltoya; hueli zampa ticcahua quen eltoya.
